provenance.upstream_manifest_purpose: real historical data loading/replay smoke test only

limitations: Six observed intervals are reused across three models; 18 scores are not 18 independent measurements.
This scores existing forecasts on an already viewed historical buoy-day; it is not new model training or independent evaluation.
NOAA hourly locations are QC/interpolated; upstream processing may use later fixes, so this does not establish raw real-time skill.
Vectors are finite differences in the fixed local spherical metric frame, not direct current measurements or instantaneous velocity.
No matched Copernicus/IOOS current field or MDMAP debris survey is connected; this residual is forecast minus observed motion.
Buoy response/depth differs from floating plastic. No polluter, source probability, interception benefit or reef impact is inferred.
Synthetic software replay only: no physical tank, camera or ocean was observed.
Four nonoverlapping differences from one synthetic track are dependent, not four independent trials.
Accepted detector quality=1 is not calibrated probability or confidence.
The deliberately imperfect frozen reference is not an ML model, water-current measurement or source prediction.
Angles are undefined if either velocity is below the declared speed threshold.
This fixture cannot validate NOAA forecasts, plastic origins, interception performance or ecological benefit.
